title: Implement a shared behavior contract
summary: Define a trait, implement it for two record types and call through a generic bound without consuming the caller’s value.

contract.clue: Keyword defining the Named behavior contract

shared.clue: Trait method receiver borrowing its implementer immutably

implementation.clue: Keyword starting the implementation of Named for User

forType.clue: Keyword connecting the implemented trait to the concrete User type

bound.clue: Trait bound requiring the name method specified in the contract

borrowed.clue: Shared reference parameter type preserving the caller’s ownership of a generic T

owned.clue: Owned UTF-8 return type of the formatted greeting

formatting.clue: Macro allocating formatted greeting text with one positional interpolation

equal.clue: Macro checking the greeting for the User implementation
